brief:
Today, Tuesday 6 October, is Push A. Your last session was Legs B on 5 October at the Singapore gym, and no push day has been logged there yet. Every push number below was earned in Warsaw or on your earlier setup, so treat the first set of each lift as a test set: if the weight is clearly off, use the nearest weight that lets you hit the reps, and log what you actually used. That log becomes the real starting point for this gym.

Three lifts could have gone up (machine chest press, reverse pec deck, overhead cable triceps) but your trainers held them for one night until the weights are confirmed on these machines. Chest press is 150, 160, 160 for 12; reverse pec deck is 100 for 12 on three sets; overhead triceps is 55 for 12 on three sets. The rest ask for more reps at the same weight: Smith incline press is 155 for 8, then three sets at 165 for 6 (up from two and a half last time); cable crossover is 14, 16, 16 for 15; dumbbell shoulder press is 45 for 10 on all three; rope pushdown is 45 for 12 on both sets.

No pain or soreness shows in any recent note. Conditioning: keep it easy today and save your legs for the next session.
